deals.deal: Classic or Spicy Chicken Sandwich for $5.99
deals.desc: Limited-time Chicken Sandwich, Classic or Spicy, for $5.99 plus tax at participating locations.

deals.deal: 2 Tacos Plus a Drink for $7
deals.desc: Everyday value deal: two tacos and a drink for about $7, part of Rubio's standing value menu, confirmed via Rubio's own email.

deals.deal: 2 Entrees for $21 (Takeout Hangout)
deals.desc: Order two entrees for $21 through the Pei Wei app or site, announced by Pei Wei Rewards email; apply the offer in your rewards account at checkout.

deals.deal: 15% Off Meals To Go Orders of $25 or More
deals.desc: Get 15% off a Hy-Vee Meals To Go prepared-food order of $25 or more; free Hy-Vee PERKS account required, announced by Hy-Vee email.

deals.deal: Traditional Turkey Dinner for 6-8, $69.99
deals.desc: Harris Teeter's weekly ad features a fully cooked Traditional Turkey Dinner serving 6 to 8, including turkey, stuffing, mashed potatoes, gravy and more, for $69.99.

deals.deal: Buy $50 in Gift Cards, Get a Free $10 Bonus Card
deals.desc: Buy $50 or more in Panera gift cards in-cafe, in the app or online and receive a free $10 bonus card redeemable in January, no code needed.

deals.deal: $7 Regular Ramen with Code RAMEN7
deals.desc: Any regular-sized ramen bowl for $7 through November 15: enter code RAMEN7 at noodles.com checkout or give the code at the counter. Open to everyone, no account needed; one per order, not on third-party delivery or catering, participating locations, while the chain's redemption cap lasts. The code and its terms are on Noodles' own offers terms page.

deals.deal: Free Delivery on Every Order Through the End of 2026
deals.desc: Through the end of 2026, delivery orders placed on mezeh.com or in the Mezeh app carry no delivery fee, for anyone, no code or account needed. Build-your-own bowls, wraps and family packs all qualify. Stated on Mezeh's own homepage.
deals.region: VA, MD, DC, PA, NC, SC, GA, FL & TX

deals.deal: Free 16 oz Cold Brew with a Chocolate Coconut Joy or Chocolate Covered Strawberry Bowl for Playa Rewards Members
deals.desc: Monday, November 9 through Friday, November 13: Playa Rewards members (free account) get a free 16 oz Playola or Sweet Cream Cold Brew with the purchase of a Chocolate Coconut Joy Bowl or Chocolate Covered Strawberry Bowl, in the shop, on playabowls.com or in the app for pickup. One redemption per member, modifiers extra, not valid on third-party delivery; participating shops while supplies last. Stated on Playa Bowls' own current-promotions page.

deals.deal: Free Birria Grilled Burrito Dipper with Any Purchase for Moe Rewards Members
deals.desc: Through Sunday, November 22: Moe Rewards members (free account) get one Grilled Burrito Dipper with the returning shredded-beef Birria free with any purchase, in the app, online or in the restaurant. Single use; the fine print says the offer goes to select members, so check the Rewards tab in the app before ordering. Not valid with dipper pans, other offers or third-party delivery; participating locations. Stated on moes.com.

deals.deal: $5 Friday: Fresh Sushi Rolls for $5
deals.desc: Every Friday, Safeway's $5 Friday lineup includes fresh sushi rolls from the in-store counter for $5 (regularly $8 to $10), alongside other prepared-food deals like an 8-piece chicken bag. Check the weekly ad for your division; a free Safeway for U account may be needed for the promo price.

deals.deal: Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's Featured Whole Sub
deals.desc: Every week Publix takes $2 off one featured whole deli sub (a Boar's Head turkey sub or the Publix Deli Ultimate Sub, for example, about $8.99 instead of $10.99), fully customizable at the counter, online or in the app. The featured sub changes with the weekly ad; the deli's weekly specials page lists it.

deals.deal: $9.99 Pita Meal Deal
deals.desc: Naf Naf Grill's value menu: a full pita meal for $9.99, in store and in the app, every day at participating locations.

deals.deal: Family Friday: $40 Meal Kit That Builds 5 Burritos or 10 Tacos
deals.desc: Every Friday, all day: a $40 meal kit with two proteins, four toppings and two sauces, enough to build five burritos or ten tacos (about $8 a burrito). In-store when you mention the deal, or online; while supplies last; no account needed. Stated on Freebirds' own homepage.

deals.deal: Buy One, Get One Free Gyros, Pitas or Appetizers with Code BOGO, Online Orders
deals.desc: Limited time at Michigan locations: add two qualifying items from the same category on the chain's own ordering site (for example a Chicken Great Greek Gyro, Feta-Filled Kebab Gyro or Falafel Pita, $10.99 to $12.99 each) and enter promo code BOGO at checkout to get one free. One BOGO per order; categories cannot be mixed; no account needed. Seen on the Byron Center, Ann Arbor, West Bloomfield, Troy and Allen Park ordering pages.

deals.deal: Choose Two for $8.99 with Code 1551: Half Salad, Soup, Sandwich or Pasta Plus a Side
deals.desc: Limited time at select cafes: any Choose Two combo (two of a half salad, half soup, half sandwich or half pasta) plus a side for $8.99, all day. Enter code 1551 at online checkout or mention it in the cafe; no account needed, not valid on third-party delivery. The offer is set cafe by cafe: it shows for Fair Oaks in Fairfax, Bethesda, both DC cafes and cafes in Illinois, Texas, Georgia, Pennsylvania and Tennessee, so pick your cafe on Corner Bakery's offers page to confirm before you go.
deals.region: Select cafes: DC, MD, VA, IL, TX, GA, PA & TN

deals.deal: Friday the 13th Tattoo BOGO: Buy One Entree, Get One Free, 3 to 4 PM
deals.desc: Friday, November 13, from 3 to 4 PM local time only: show any tattoo at the register (a real one, a temporary one or a drawn-on one all count) and get a second entree of equal or lesser value free with each entree you buy, up to five free per check. In-restaurant only at participating U.S. and Canada locations; no account needed; not valid on app, online, delivery or catering orders, and kids' meals do not count as the purchased entree. Stated in Chipotle's own November 9 newsroom release.

deals.deal: $5 Core and $7 Premium Pizzas After 5 PM on Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays
deals.desc: Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays after 5 PM: Double Cheese or Pepperoni pizzas for $5 and Meaty, Supreme, Veggie or BBQ Chicken and Jalapeno pizzas for $7, in-store or online, no account needed. Select locations while supplies last; excludes add-ons, kids' pizzas and gluten-free crust; not valid with other offers or third-party delivery. Stated on Schlotzsky's own offers page.
deals.expires: Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays after 5 PM

deals.deal: $5 Off Two Regular Rice Bowls with Code CE41FLDF
deals.desc: Standing coupon on Yoshinoya's own coupons page: add two regular rice bowls (chicken, beef or veggie) in-store, online or in the app and apply code CE41FLDF at checkout for $5 off; no account needed. Not valid on ribeye, salmon or limited-time items; participating locations. The same page lists $5 off two large bowls (code CRSA6MCE), $5 off two combo bowls (C6Z88J4A) and 20% off $20 (C9M7P979), 25% off $25 (C3FBHN3D) or 30% off $30 (up to $10 off).

deals.deal: Double Fire Deal: Two Charbroiled Chicken or Tofu Bowls with Two Add-Ons for $20
deals.desc: Limited time: two charbroiled chicken or tofu rice bowls plus two add-ons for $20 together, at participating locations, no account or code needed. Flame Broiler bowls are usually about $11 to $12 each before add-ons. Stated on Flame Broiler's own homepage.

deals.deal: $1 Bottomless Fountain Drinks for PERi-Perks Members
deals.desc: PERi-Perks members (free account) can add a bottomless fountain drink to any meal for $1 instead of the usual $3.99, in app, online or in-restaurant.
deals.region: DC, MD, VA, IL, TX & GA

deals.deal: Kids Eat Free: Free Chicken or Tofu Mini Bowl with Each Full-Price Entree
deals.desc: Every day: one free kids Chicken or Tofu Mini Bowl with the purchase of any full-price entree, weekdays after 4 PM and all day Saturday and Sunday, at all WaBa Grill locations. No account or coupon needed. Stated in WaBa Grill's own press release and on its homepage.
deals.expires: Weekdays after 4 PM, all day weekends

deals.deal: Free Upsize Friday: 32 oz Smoothie for the Price of a 20 oz
deals.desc: Every Friday, Healthy Rewards members (free account required) get a 32 oz smoothie for the price of a 20 oz when they order in the Smoothie King app, at participating locations. Rewards cannot be redeemed on these orders.
